tasks.title: MidiSong models
tasks.prompt: Create lib/models/midi_song.dart (pure Dart, no Flutter imports) and test/models/midi_song_test.dart. Do NOT modify lib/models/midi_pattern.dart. Define: enum MidiRole { drums, bass, guitar, keys, strings, vocal, lead, synth, other } with a `static MidiRole fromName(String? n)` (unknown/null -> other). Parsed (non-serialized, in-memory) types: class MidiNote {final int tick; final int dur; final int pitch; final int vel;}, class TempoChange {final int tick; final int microsPerQuarter;}, class TimeSigChange {final int tick; final int numerator; final int denominator;}, class MidiTrackData {final int index; final String name; final int channel; final int program; final List<MidiNote> notes;} with getters noteCount, minPitch, maxPitch (0 when empty), class MidiSongData {final int ppq; final List<TempoChange> tempos; final List<TimeSigChange> timeSigs; final List<MidiTrackData> tracks;} with getter initialBpm (60000000/first tempo or 120). Stored (serializable, metadata ONLY, never notes) types: class MidiTrackMeta {index, name, channel, program, detectedRole (MidiRole), roleOverride (MidiRole?), mute (bool, default false), volume (double 0..1, default 1.0), noteCount, minPitch, maxPitch} with `MidiRole get role => roleOverride ?? detectedRole`, copyWith, toJson/fromJson; class MidiSongMeta {static const int schemaVersion = 1; final String? fileUrl; final int ppq; final double initialBpm; final List<MidiTrackMeta> tracks;} with copyWith, toJson (includes 'schemaVersion') and fromJson (tolerant of missing fields and unknown extra keys). Tests: JSON round-trip, override beats detected, tolerant fromJson, and a size guard: a MidiSongMeta with 64 tracks serializes (jsonEncode) to under 20000 chars. Follow the style of lib/models/midi_pattern.dart.
tasks.verify: flutter test test/models/midi_song_test.dart && rg -q 'class MidiSongMeta' lib/models/midi_song.dart && git diff --quiet HEAD -- lib/models/midi_pattern.dart

tasks.title: Instrument role detection
tasks.prompt: Create lib/services/audio/midi/role_detect.dart (pure Dart). It must `import '../../../models/midi_song.dart';` which already defines enum MidiRole {drums, bass, guitar, keys, strings, vocal, lead, synth, other}. Implement `MidiRole detectRole({required int channel, required int program, String name = '', int minPitch = 0, int maxPitch = 127})`. channel is 0-based (9 = General MIDI drums). Rules in order: channel==9 -> drums; else if name (lowercased) contains a keyword: drum/perc -> drums, bass -> bass, guitar/gtr -> guitar, vocal/vox/voice/choir/sing -> vocal, piano/keys/organ -> keys, string/violin/cello -> strings, lead/melody/solo -> lead; else by General MIDI program: 0-23 keys, 24-31 guitar, 32-39 bass, 40-55 strings (but 52-54 vocal), 56-79 lead, 80-103 synth, 104-127 other; program 0 with no name hint and maxPitch<=55 -> bass. Add `bool isPercussionChannel(int channel) => channel == 9;`. Keep it a single small file, no classes.
tasks.verify: dart analyze lib/services/audio/midi/role_detect.dart && rg -q 'MidiRole detectRole' lib/services/audio/midi/role_detect.dart

tasks.title: Role detection tests
tasks.prompt: Create test/midi/role_detect_test.dart: a table-driven test for detectRole in lib/services/audio/midi/role_detect.dart covering: channel 9 -> drums regardless of program; program 33 -> bass; 25 -> guitar; 0 -> keys; 40 -> strings; 53 -> vocal; 73 -> lead; 81 -> synth; name 'Lead Vox' -> vocal beats program; name 'Bass' -> bass; program 0 with maxPitch 48 and no name -> bass; unknown/empty -> other for program 112. Fix role_detect.dart ONLY if the specified rules in its own doc/spec are violated; otherwise change nothing in lib/.

tasks.title: Multi-track SMF song parser
tasks.prompt: Create lib/services/audio/midi/smf_song_parser.dart with `MidiSongData parseSmfSong(Uint8List bytes)` returning the MidiSongData/MidiTrackData/MidiNote/TempoChange/TimeSigChange types from lib/models/midi_song.dart. Reuse the existing byte reader/chunk logic in lib/services/audio/midi/smf_parser.dart: you may ONLY make its reader class non-private (rename, no behavior change) so both files share it; parseDrumSmf and its behavior and every existing test in test/midi/ must stay unchanged and green. The new parser must: accept SMF format 0 and 1 with PPQ timing (throw FormatException for SMPTE timing, format 2, bad header); handle running status, meta events (tempo 0x51 -> TempoChange with absolute tick, time signature 0x58 with denominator 2^n, track name 0x03), sysex skip; track Program Change (0xC0) per channel (use the most recent program on that channel at note start; bank select ignored); pair note-on (velocity>0) with note-off (0x80 or note-on vel 0) per (channel,pitch) to produce MidiNote with tick and dur (dur at least 1; unterminated notes end at track end); split a track that uses several channels into one MidiTrackData per (track index, channel); drop tracks with no notes; absolute ticks (no quantizing, no 4-bar cap); name falls back to 'Track N'. Write test/midi/smf_song_parser_test.dart building byte fixtures in the test helper (a tiny SMF builder function): multi-track with a tempo change, running status, two channels in one track, note-off via vel 0, SMPTE rejection, truncated file throws FormatException.

tasks.title: Build MidiSongMeta from parsed song
tasks.prompt: Create lib/services/audio/midi/midi_song_meta_builder.dart exporting `MidiSongMeta buildMidiSongMeta(MidiSongData song, {String? fileUrl, MidiSongMeta? previous})`. For each MidiTrackData make a MidiTrackMeta with detectedRole = detectRole(channel:, program:, name:, minPitch:, maxPitch:) from role_detect.dart, noteCount/minPitch/maxPitch from the data, mute false, volume 1.0. If `previous` is given, carry over roleOverride/mute/volume for tracks matching by index+channel. Use song.initialBpm and song.ppq. Test with a small hand-built MidiSongData (no file parsing): channel 9 track -> drums, program 33 -> bass, override carried over from previous.
